text: Look at life’s difficulties as riddles or quests. Instead of blaming someone or perceiving a difficulty as punishment (“Why is this happening to me?”), ask yourself: “What must I learn in this situation? What skill should I develop? What illusion should I cast off?”. Such a view turns you from a victim of circumstances into a hero going through a spiritual path. Sometimes read myths and fairy tales so that it is easier for you to switch ajna to this wave.
